article.title: Northern Arizona visits No. 24 Kentucky following Diallo's 24-point outing
article.linkText: Northern Arizona visits No. 24 Kentucky following Diallo's 24-point outing
article.story: Northern Arizona Lumberjacks (0-3) at Kentucky Wildcats (2-1) Lexington, Kentucky; Friday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Wildcats -35.5; over/under is 155.5 BOTTOM LINE: No. 24 Kentucky hosts Northern Arizona after Zoom Diallo scored 24 points in Kentucky's 89-69 loss to the Kansas Jayhawks. Kentucky went 14-4 at home last season while going 22-14 overall. The Wildcats allowed opponents to score 74.3 points per game and shoot 42.6% from the field last season. Northern Arizona finished 1-13 on the road and 10-22 overall a season ago. The Lumberjacks allowed opponents to score 76.4 points per game and shot 48.2% from the field last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
